article: HUMANIZED-SO-FAR.md at ae8acc3a: the ketone decision with Strategy A, and Strategy B with its fat, protein and guide lines (his post's blocks 95-96 and 98-100), read beside his post's by the lead session, sentence by sentence (E284, E294). His 'This determines your electrolyte protocol' is said as its reason (BHB salts bring sodium, a keto diet drains it; his Part 3 says not to load salt on Strategy A); 'fast' and 'for the long run' come from his own Part 4 timeline; 'EAT FAT TO SATIETY. This is your new energy source.' is 'That only works if fat becomes your fuel, so eat fat until you're full'; 'Do not rely on lean protein alone' is 'Don't fill up on lean protein ... instead', the same warning with what it is instead of; 'side effects' is named as the keto flu (his guide's address). Nothing reads worse; both paragraphs are on his cards page as his to rewrite (K-1, K-2).
